card.name: Trailing digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: The last digit or number piece in a written quantity, mostly a 0 ending a dose such as 10, 40 or 2800, or the 'mill' and 'million' in a quantity. It appears mainly in dosing text with units next.

modes.label: Final zero in rounded doses
modes.description: A 0 or other digit that completes a number right before a unit like mg, units or IU.
